apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkoutservice
  namespace: boutique

spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: checkoutservice
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: checkoutservice
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: checkoutservice
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
        - name: server
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
